<thought>Search the template catalog using broken functional groups ketones, aromatic hydroxyls, and C‑C double bonds, and formed ether oxygens. No bond specifications are needed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
